title: Secret-manager pointers used as credential values
summary: Values in the grammars of secret managers: op://Benchmark/database/password for 1Password, os.environ/BENCHMARK_API_KEY for LiteLLM, a GCP secret-version path, and a ref+vault:// reference.
rationale: A pointer says where a secret is stored without disclosing it. Each manager has its own grammar, so supporting one leaves the others as false alarms.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. Each value is a well-formed pointer in a documented secret-manager grammar and carries no secret.

incidents.summary: Preserve Azure App Service Key Vault references in contextual detection
